description: An EU-based software vendor that sells bookkeeping SaaS to obliged entities but is NOT itself an obliged entity. It does not inherit its customers' AML duties. Example profile.
assumptions: Vendor role is declared: the vendor does NOT perform KYC/AML screening itself, so FCS-AML-001 applicability is its customers', not the vendor's.
No card data (no pan/sad categories); FCS-PAN-001/FCS-SAD-001 do not apply to this profile.
GDPR data-subject rights apply to pii_identity and marketing_consent; transaction_records may carry a legal-hold retention conflict modeled per category.
